full_judgment: 2. The petitioners as plaintiffs filed Title Suit 103 of 2010 on 26-5-2010 in the Court of Joint District Judge, Court No.2, Gazipur against as many as 310 defendants and the suit was filed for partition. The land is 22.77 acres out of which plaintiffs claimed 500.59 decimals of land from CS Khatian 32 corresponding to SA Khatians 27, 70, 71, 73, 74, 75, 76, 77, 78, 97, 72 and RS Khatians 83, 74, 72, 58, 17, 53, 48, 24, 14, 8 and 6. In the suit, the Government is also one of the defendant being co-sharer on the basis of Land Acquisition Case 41 of 1961-62.
